answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by binding each agent identity to a unique proof-of-stake relic anchored in a verifiable delay function, so forged identities cannot reuse past work. A rotating committee then operates as a lantern, cross-attesting stake-weighted state transitions and pruning shadow identities that drift like grains on a dune. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
